data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'chandana', meaning 'sandalwood'. In Hindu mythology, sandalwood is considered sacred and is often used in religious rituals and for making idols. The name Chandana carries the meaning “Sandalwood” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandana usually hope their child will grow to embody sandalwood and live with faith, good character and purpose.
